therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of gastrointestinal toxicity from preparatory regimen and GVHD prophylaxis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with hematological malignancies undergoing stem cell transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of grades III-IV GI toxicity at 30 days

results.effect_size: 21 participants experienced grades III-IV GI toxicity out of enrolled cohort
biomarker_changes: Citrulline and fecal calprotectin levels measured as biomarkers of GI tract health
results.dose_information: Daily dosing for 5 days before stem cell transplant, day of transplant, and 8 days following transplant

context.duration: Treatment for 14 days total, follow-up for 1 year
